articleTitle: Inventory management for depreciating items with stochastic demand
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We develop an inventory management model for depreciating items whose depreciation process is assumed to be of a linear or exponential trend with white noise volatility, while the demand is also considered to be stochastic. The model is formulated under the assumption that replenishments only occur at discrete time points over a fixed planning horizon. Through this model, we obtain the optimal replenishment policy, including the time schedule and the quantity per order. Finally, when the decline of the purchasing cost is considered, we derive an extension to the model.

articleTitle: Cross training for efficient and flexible service system portfolios
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper proposes using cross training to create efficient server portfolios for multi-class service systems which usually use specialized access channels and servers for different types of service. Such a system is seen to satisfy customers with the high service quality, but it isn't robust enough to the volatile demand coming from each channel. Workforce flexibility, which can be obtained by cross training, provides the possibility of centralizing demands from all channels and thus increases system responsiveness. However, cross training may decrease system efficiency, in the sense that it lowers servers' average skill level. It is desirable for service systems to satisfy responsiveness and efficiency simultaneously. Therefore, we seek a reasonable tradeoff betweens these two criteria. In this paper, cross training decisions are supported by multi-criteria optimization models, and thus efficient server portfolios can be generated if servers are cross trained in this way.

articleTitle: The method integration model for partner selection in the virtual enterprise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of partner selection model in the virtual enterprise at present, which do not in common and not benefit to reuse in software realization, a method integration model using the fuzzy clustering to solve that problem has been proposed. An example is illustrated to how to select partners in the virtual enterprise using this model.

articleTitle: The effects of service quality management practices on customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This research is to examine the impact of service quality system on customer satisfaction and reuse intentions. For these purposes, the author investigated the antecedents and consequence of service system in the hotel service industry. Five factors (reliability, assurance, tangibles, empathy and responsiveness) were identified that potentially impact service system and service performances. The results showed that direct relationships between service inputs (assurance, empathy, and responsiveness) and service system. The data also reveal that tangibles and the service system have strong, positive, and direct relationship with customer satisfaction. Customer satisfaction has strong relationship with reuse. The implications of the results on service quality management are discussed.

articleTitle: Modeling diffusion of innovation with cellular automata
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Due to the lack of individual-level data, CA models that are based on individual-level theory are difficult to be validated quantitatively. In this paper, we present an approach by which we can derive the parameters of CA model from aggregate-level data so that the presented model can be used for the prediction of Internet users' quantity in the future. The result of simulation suggests that the forecasting precision of the presented model is nearly equal to the aggregate-level model (Bass model). Moreover, this model can reproduce the pattern of Internet diffusion in the aggregate-level by the interacting of individual level units, which could not be educed by the Bass model.

articleTitle: Foreign direct investment and technological progress
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the channels through which the FDI affect technological progress and explicitly analyzes the mechanism of effect meanwhile. We conclude that the degrees of stimulation in human resources and in R&D are associated with the proportional of foreign presence.

articleTitle: A research on cross-cultural e-marketing in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The concepts of the cultural difference, cross-cultural marketing, and cross-cultural e-marketing are discussed. The relationship between cross-cultural marketing and cross-national marketing and the relationship between cross-cultural marketing and cultural marketing are also discussed. On this basis, the problems of applying the cross-cultural e-marketing in China are pointed out and the countermeasures against these problems are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on the orientation of Tianjin's logistics industry in economic circle around Bo Sea
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The logistics industry has been growing from strength to strength since China started implementing a market economy. China's logistics industry is still at a nascent stage. But it is fortunate that China have started to reform its old circulation system and speed up the development of its logistics industry. Many cities begin to plan and carry out the logistics strategy including Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin and so on. Now the region around Bo Sea in China became the economic developing focus in china. In this paper, our aim is to compare the current situation of Tianjin's logistics industry with other regions around Bo Sea and establish its development strategy, which should be coordination with other regions. We analyze Tianjin's logistics industry from a new perspective and design a new framework to state the current situation systematically. According to large numbers of statistic data, we analyze the advantages and disadvantage of Tianjin's logistics industry, and then put forward its new orientation.

articleTitle: A Lagrangian relaxation approach for solving short-term air traffic flow management model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In order to solve the short-term air traffic flow management problem (ST-TFMP) efficiently, we present an algorithm using Lagrangian relaxation technique. The primal problem is decoupled by relaxing the air route capacity constraints, and then the corresponding dual problem is solved by subgradient method. We also propose a heuristic procedure in combination with the knowledge of air traffic management. It forces the dual solution from infeasible to feasible by adding non-coupled constraints. At last, the algorithm is validated by practical data from the Beijing ATC Center of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC). The computational results show that the algorithm can improve the performance of ST-TFMP.

articleTitle: Mobile data services and mobile decision support
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Traditional decision support may not consider real-time and mobility of user terminals, and bring some inconveniences to mobile users for accessing database and making decision. Data play important role in decision-making. The paper presents a mobile data services architecture, discusses device-related, user-related and historical data in mobile process, and describes mobile decision support architecture related to data accessed in mobile terminal.

articleTitle: Reputation mechanism based online lemon problems solving system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The Internet has greatly influenced the classic analyzing background of Akerlof's lemon problems, as dealers tend to have more severe speculative intentions than that in traditional economy, which consequently may lead to the deteriorating lemon problems. The paper has done in the following aspects: stated the worsening possibilities of lemon problems in the Internet environment; specified the operating mechanism of dual-rating reputation system and figured out the shortcomings; comparatively analyzed the efficiency of dual quality factor involved reputation system through discussing the problems of reputation system with buyer quality factor related only; and finally proposed a dual quality factors based reputation mechanism solution for online lemon problems.

articleTitle: Applications of data warehousing and data mining in the retail industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The information economy puts a premium on high quality actionable information - exactly what business intelligence (BI) tools like data warehousing, data mining, and OLAP can provide to the retailers. A close look at the different retail organizational functions suggests that BI can play a crucial role in almost every function. It can give new and often surprising insights about customer behavior; thereby helping the retailers meet their ever-changing needs and desires. On the supply side, BI can help retailers identify their best vendors and determine what separates them from not so good vendors. It can give retailers better understanding of inventory' and its movement and also help improve storefront operations through better category management Through a host of analyses and reports, BI can also improve retailers' internal organizational support functions like finance and human resource management.

articleTitle: Simulation of personalized services in SIP communications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: A Web-based system is designed and implemented to simulate advanced services in a session initiation protocol (SIP) environment, including system basic services and personalized services (policies). Described in extended call processing language (CPL), personal policies are programmed by end users via graphic user interfaces (GUIs) and are automatically translated into extended CPL. The simulation system presented in this paper clearly displays what CPL policies should be used for the provision of presence services and call-processing services. Policy conflicts can be addressed by setting policy priority in the simulation system.

articleTitle: Service performance analysis on SIP powered multimedia networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper proposes to establish a simple Web-based service performance tool that simulates selected normal and abnormal operations of an SIP powered network. Based on this tool, a variety of multimedia service traffic is supported. The tool is used to analyze the service performance of respective network elements in a simulated SIP environment, where traffic of different service types and management procedures is generated under different network configurations and scenario setups. The analytical study supports one service types initially: VoIP (voice over Internet protocol), and is extended to study other service types such as voice-band data call and fax. The user can input the desired service types, traffic volumes and distributions, and configure the service proceeding scenario interactively through the friendly input format from any client. The service performance study under this simulated network is especially useful to the service providers who are currently offering Internet-based services or have been planning new services aggressively. Service impacts due to resource bottleneck are noticed by active operators so improvement or enhancement can be implemented in time before problems start developing. The operation of service network can be simulated under a controlled circumstance so new services can be introduced with the required support capacity specified to reflect the quality level the service network can offer.

articleTitle: The model of Internet marketing program considering 2Is
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper advocates the model of Internet marketing program considering interactivity and individualization (abr.2Is). Firstly, the paper gives the definition and the function of 2Is; secondly, the author analyzes the influence on the Internet marketing of 2Is, and sets up the influence models respectively; thirdly, the paper establish a model for Internet marketing program considering 2Is.

articleTitle: The risk identification and monitoring of electronic business
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the rapid development and wide applying of Internet technology, many enterprises are eager to do business through Internet. However, concerning the electronic business, the risk does not reduce but increases for the management circumstances and operating mode have changed greatly, which make traditional risk management confronted with challenges. How to identify and control risk is sticking point to run electronic business successfully. In this article, three kinds of risk factors of electronic business according to the risk sources are identified and analyzed particularly. Then, the risk monitoring process and the risk real-time monitoring system for electronic business based on this process is also presented. This system consists of five functional modules and one data interface. These five functional modules including data definition, data analysis, risk identification, risk monitoring and risk perfection are discussed in detail. The risk real-time monitoring system can be used to manage the risks in every stage of electronic business lifecycle, and can be applied in other fields.

articleTitle: The problems of the outstanding claims reserve and the IBNR claims reserve - a queuing model method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper studies the outstanding claims reserve and the incurred but not reported (INBR) claims reserve by establishing their queueing models. We give the distributions and bounds of the outstanding and IBNR claims reserve. Furthermore, we also give an example.

articleTitle: A study on managing the gaps of hotel service quality expectations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In hotels, there are more or less gaps of service quality expectations because the management, the front-staff and guests perform different roles respectively and each possesses unequal message. To effectively meet guests' needs and expectations, promises for guests should be made felicitously and guests' expectations of service quality should be kept at a rational level on the basis of comprehending guests' needs and expectations of service quality via market research. Meanwhile, to reduce or even eliminate the gaps of service quality expectations, the message about their mutual expectations of service quality should be punctually and precisely passed to the other party by the communication system inside and outside the hotel.

articleTitle: Data mining application in prosecution committee for unsupervised learning
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Feature selection is effective in removing irrelevant data. However, the result of feature selection in unsupervised learning is not as satisfying as that in supervised learning. In this paper, we make a comprehensive overview of existing methods of feature selection in unsupervised learning and propose a novel methodology ULAC (feature selection for unsupervised learning based on attribute correlation analysis and clustering algorithm) to identify important features for unsupervised learning. We also apply ULAC and practical data mining framework into a prosecution committee to solve the real world application for unsupervised learning.

articleTitle: Information sharing with scarce goods in Cournot retailers
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper studies the incentives for firms to share information vertically in a two-level supply chain formed by one upstream manufacturer with limited production capacity, and many downstream retailers. The retailers are engaged in a Cournot competition, and are endowed with some private demand information. We show that a discriminated allocation strategy may encourage retailers to share information, and we generate the optimal parameter for the equilibrium of information sharing.

articleTitle: Credit system of the food safety in retail trade based on information technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The aim of this paper is to address the following problems that are becoming increasingly important to managers in food retail industries. Whether the guarantee of food safety is the key way to promote service level of food retail and enhance customer satisfaction? If yes, how to reinforce the food safety management? What are advantages of applying information technology in building credit system of food safety (CSFS)? How does CSFS influence customer satisfaction? Based on analyzing the basic principles, framework of CSFS and elucidating the role of food retailer, food enterprises and customers in CSFS respectively, the paper introduces how does CSFS integrate whole food supply chain to ensure food safety and what are the functions of CSFS in food safety management through information technology. Based on prior researches which focus on factors affecting customer satisfaction, the paper elaborates on the impacts of CSFS on these factors and its results, and also finds that CSFS based on information technology not only promote service level of food retail through ensuring food safety, but also enhance customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Detecting the content related parts of Web pages
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Many Web pages are semantic diverse. That is, the whole content of a Web page is not consistent to address one topic. However, current search engines are page-oriented (other than topic-oriented). But, most Web users retrieve their target information by topics. Therefore, how to partition Web pages by semantics is one of interesting research topics. In this paper, we firstly build a tree (called semantic tree, ST) to partition the Web page into the content parts (called semantic part, SP) based on the Web page tags. Then we analyze the characteristics of the words (or terms) appearing on the Web page in order to build a term weighting formula. Based on these term weight values we employ the similarity formula to calculate the semantic similar degree between each two SPs. Finally, we consider the balance point of precision and recall as the reference value of the similarity - threshold. Through the work above we can find the content-related parts (or segmentations) of a Web page. And we achieved a satisfied result.

articleTitle: Marketing strategy of price competition and product differentiation in duopoly enterprises with asymmetric information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Models of two-stage and three-stage games are set up in this article according to the Hotelling linear model. In the models, one-round pricing of products concerning the differentiated cost and the asymmetric information for duopoly enterprises is considered. The marketing strategy of price competition and product differentiation is discussed. And it must result in such a situation that both sides can obtain higher price and more profit in Stackelberg equilibrium than that in Nash equilibrium. Moreover, under the Bertrand-Stackelberg marketing competition equilibrium, the follower has the advantage of surpassing the former one and can make more profit than the leading one.

articleTitle: Research on the service recovery system of Chinese real estate industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Real estate industry as the third industry of national economy, it plays the important role strengthening service management, decreasing the possibility of service failure and making the service recovery work better. It can guarantee the continuity of real estate industry offering service, circulation of the supply and demand chain and stability of profit chain. On the basis of qualitative analysis of the service recovery system (SRS), the study takes Chinese real estate industry as the design object, analyzes the affecting service failure factors from the customer view, realizes the anticipative aim according to the input-output principle and designs the SRS in term of the time series. Through the questionnaire of real estate enterprise executing the SRS, the results show that the solved problem ratio is increasing and time space shorten. And the different culture background of different enterprise, the attitude of enterprise employee and whether taking the immediate measures are the subjective and uncertain factors. These are the main factors affecting the overall system execution.

articleTitle: Customer's perceived service quality of Internet retailing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The study has investigated the consumer's perceived e-retailing service quality in the Internet context The results of the study reveal that consumer's perceptions of online retailing service quality have eight dimensions: reliability, convenience, diversity, availability, responsiveness, empathy, post-service, and security. Researchers and online marketers may develop better understanding their customers, marketing strategies, and e-store architects to attract potential consumers adopt the online retailing services and retention current customers.

articleTitle: A prototype system for using structured document to support knowledge sharing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: By applying the principles of structured document, this paper puts forward a new solution for knowledge sharing. In this paper, dual scaling method and spring model are used for building and visualizing the relation of the documents. Then this paper introduces an ongoing project that is to develop a prototype system, which integrate individual knowledge and share it to other members automatically.

articleTitle: The applied research of inheritance workflow design in B2B e-commerce
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: According to object-oriented programming thought, this text is on the basis of workflow design using Petri net, and put forward an approach of inheritance workflow to solve the design of interorganizational workflows, designing such workflows in such a way that business partners preserve their autonomy as well as tightly co-operation. This promotes the development of business-to-business e-commerce. In the article, we take an instance for analysis.

articleTitle: A research on reciprocity mechanism among tourism enterprises based on shared service management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Starting from the promotion of whole coordinative development of the tourism industry, this paper analyzes problems, such as excessive competition, increasing operation cost, and falling service quality. Based on the theories of shared service management, it puts forward a primitive reciprocity mechanism among tourism enterprises that may help to cut the cost as well as to improve service. According to the basic theory of repeated games, it carries out further research on the incentive function of the reciprocity mechanism that may encourage enterprises to establish a shared service. Four technical approaches to realize reciprocity among tourism enterprises are presented.

articleTitle: Application research of effective space on logistics system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Storage takes important role in logistics system, and improving the availability of it, decreasing the workload of cargo handling, and ensuring the exace location of goods have direct influence on improving velocity of goods circulation and reducing stock-holding cost While, cargo loading takes important role in logistics and delivery, and the efficiency of it also has great influence on improving whole efficiency of logistics system and reducing transport cost. In this paper, author has put forward a kind of practical and feasible solution of this kind of problem on the basis of the algorithm of the effective space. And the three-dimensional loading method based on it can improve the traditional spatial division method effectively. It is easy to program by its space analytical method, and it is provided with high efficiency of loading.

articleTitle: Analyzing cause of supply chain competitive advantage based on price transferring mechanism between partners
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Analyzing the cause of supply chain competitive advantage is the basis for further research works in supply chain competitive advantage. This paper intends to bring a new sight to the above question. Starting from the main partner classification and the relationship analysis among these partners, this paper first explains the price transferring mechanism existing between direct connected partners in the horizontal structure of supply chain. Based on the competitive advantage explanation provided by the resource-based view theory, the paper puts forward the formulae of partner competitive advantage contribution and supply chain competitive advantage. Through comparison of these formulae, we conclude that the supply chain competitive advantage is actually composed of partner's competitive advantage contribution, but it is not the simply parallel summation of these contributions. It is rather the transferring of partner's competitive advantage contribution one partner after another along the horizontal structure of supply chain, and finally accumulated in the last horizontal partners that create the supply chain competitive advantage. This idea might be more useful for further research work on supply chain competitive advantage analysis.

articleTitle: TD-SCDMA-based 3G mobile business value proposition and alliance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: TD-SCDMA, which was developed and promoted by China, is one of the third-generation (3G) mobile telecommunications transmission standards, together with CDMA2000 and WCDMA. Building competitive advantage based on the TD-SCDMA standard is believed to have the potential of making China move up the value chain in its mobile telecommunication industry. This paper analyzes the elements of the evolving mobile business value chain and emphasizes the importance of building alliance among all the industry players, standard setting organizations and government agencies.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: A kind of data warehouse in community healthcare service system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Chinese health care industry is increasingly becoming a community-based style, it is hoped that the community healthcare service model can efficiently connect hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and customers for sharing information, reducing administrative costs and improving the quality of care. Thus, the successful community healthcare depends critically on the collection, analysis and seamless exchange of residents, clinical, pharmacies and other utilization health information or knowledge within and across the above organizational boundaries. In this paper, a data warehouse-enabled community healthcare management system that would help to integrate residents, hospitals, pharmacies and governments in healthcare was put forward through a common technical architecture. According to the characteristics of different roles, a subject-oriented information share model is also discussed. Hence, the objective of this research is to present and describe the community healthcare service system in China, the technical infrastructure of data warehouse, and the decision support architecture for such a healthcare management system. The research findings would immensely help the development of healthcare community in China, and improve the healthcare service quality from the point of view of residents.

articleTitle: Calculation method for portfolio's value at risk based on principal factor analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In this paper, we propose principal factor analysis method to reduce the dimensions of a high dimensional random vector in calculating portfolio's value at risk. The theoretical foundation, algorithm and numerical example of the method are given. This method outperforms the principal component analysis method. Especially, the advantages of the method are marked, while the factors F's multicollinearity is serious.

articleTitle: Knowledge management support of real-time decision making for customer service support systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Knowledge management causes not only the continuous innovation patterns of customer service, but also synergic matching of customer service support and real-time decision making. Prompt response to customer service problems is needed to maintain customer satisfaction. Therefore, a good CSSS must be set up and analyzed. This paper has presented a meta knowledge model of CSSS based on KM support that encompasses three KM support patterns, business modeling and all problems of real decision making from time, customer and environment limited. We described business modeling for CSSS relevant static model, dynamic model and rules model based on enterprise common knowledge analysis performed on executable a real-time service decision making.

articleTitle: Characteristic analysis of dissipative structure in logistics system and establishment of entropy differentiation model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Dissipative structure theory is one of the three new modern theories. In recent years, the theory is demonstrating a promising in social and economic areas. In this paper analyses are conducted on entropy, effect of entropy increasing, and dissipative structure features in logistics system, based on entropy theory and dissipative structure theory. Finally, an entropy differentiation model is set up to analyze the stability of operation and development of logistics system. A simple calculation is also given in this paper. The above finding may provide new study idea for effective management of scientific logistics system.

articleTitle: Financial service innovation based on grid computing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In a world of economic globalization, financial industry faces many new challenges. Optimizing IT infrastructure utilization is one way to advance financial organizations' competitiveness. Web service and grid computing appear to be increasing useful tools to realize the aim. Using existing computing resources to provide innovative financial service is the subject of the paper. Grid-based (American) stock option trading brokerage as an example, system architecture and its main issues, high-performance option pricing platform is designed. Using Web service and Java technologies, test system is set up, ideal speedup and pricing results are achieved. According to IBM's grid value at work model, the grid system business value is analysed in quantitative approach. Low total cost of ownership (TOC), high return on investment (ROI) and internal rate of return (IRR) denote that grid-based stock option brokerage is a effective value-added service for financial institution.

articleTitle: The research on the development of the telecommunication service & the telecommunication's interactive and comprehensive service model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Technology and market together impel the telecommunication industry to implement leap-forward development. The content of the telecommunication service evolves continuously, changing from network service, sales service, information service to the interactive & comprehensive service, convergence service. This thesis constructs the model of the telecommunication's interactive & comprehensive service, implementing the interactive equilibrium between the telecommunication service and the consumers' service demand.

articleTitle: An auto-surveillance net based on expressway monitor video
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the rapid growth of expressway in China, the monitor video in expressway is also increased, and a surveillance-net is gradually formed, in order to manage all the videos automatically, in this paper, a framework of real-time auto-surveillance net based on a robust recognition and tracking strategy is studied. Recognition is focused on the ROI of the video, and a pixel weight based high-level information abstraction is used to get the detail information of the objects. A hypothesis based tracking is used to maintain correspondences between objects identified at successive recognition instants to provide spatio-temporal trajectories. Results of experiment by dealing with expressway video are obtained, which demonstrate the accuracy and time responses.

articleTitle: Meanings of the knowledge in knowledge management
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: "Knowledge" is the most important characteristic for the knowledge economy age, and the key resource for the development of an individual, an organization, a nation and even all the world. So, knowledge management appeared as a new specialty. Understanding knowledge exactly is the premise for managing knowledge. This article is focused on understanding the "knowledge" through researching on different fields of philosophy, economics, managerial science and information technology, and from several angles such as hypostatic attributes and origin of the knowledge, cognitive process, the roles in the economic growth of the whole society and the continuable increase of the enterprises played by knowledge, and distinguishing knowledge from others in practice.

articleTitle: Value creating from exchanges among organizational value chain activities - the case study of District Educational Hospital
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The value chain activities within organizations are inevitably succeeded with the resource input from the upstream suppliers. As the same rule, the output of organization's value activities will be passing to its customers as input of them. In other words, the value creating activities involve the internal value chain of specific focal firm. Also the external value chain of upstream suppliers and downstream customers, which are connected by exchange behavior between businesses and construct an industry-wide value chain system namely value network. The value chain is composed of the main value activities of organizational management processes (including the department of supporting functions and value process). As for the connection for external resources combined with the internal management processes, it is required supporting value activities including technology, motivation, and improvement of human capability.

articleTitle: Analyzing the impact of operation strategies on quality management in selected enterprises of electronic equipment manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Based upon the strategic significance of enterprises, setting about from the core competence of them, we carried on an empirical analysis to the factors which affect the quality. In this empirical research, we analyzed the 2001y-to-2003y data which come from selected 20 electronic enterprises and are related to the process of enterprise operation. In addition, the evaluation result of the "TOP-100 list of Chinese electronic enterprise on quality" is adopted for this analysis. On the basis of the empirical analysis, through a comparison between the theoretical result and the empirical result, the paper has offered some enlightenment to the improvement of quality management system under the environment of China.

articleTitle: Dynamic lot sizing models with bounded inventory and backlogging
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper addresses a real life single item dynamic lot sizing problem arising in a refinery for crude oil procurement. It can be considered as a lot-sizing problem with bounded inventory and backlogging. The production capacity can be considered to be unlimited and the production cost functions are assumed to be linear but time-varying. The results can be easily extended to concave piecewise linear production cost functions. The goal is to minimize the total costs of production, inventory holding and backlogging. We show that the problem can be solved in O(T2) time with general concave inventory holding and backlogging cost functions where T is the number of periods in the planning horizon. We show that the complexity is reduced to O(T) when the inventory holding cost functions are linear and have some required properties.

articleTitle: Managing hot XML data in memory for high performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the fast development of computer communication and especially the Internet and Web technology, more and more service activities have been conducted on the Internet. An important quality criterion for Internet-based services is performance, usually measured by response time. Performance has been a key to provide satisfactory services to end customers and to survive in severe competition. In this research, we developed Internet main memory database (MMDB) techniques to reduce response time of XML databases, which are becoming a kind of mainstream databases in e-commerce and Internet-based services. In this paper, we describe the techniques we developed to manage hot XML data in memory for high performance. The core part of the techniques is a memory-resident index that is aimed to making the best use of the processor cache memory for the best possible performance.

articleTitle: Extending product family approach to support services
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The product family (PF) approach is broadly adopted to develop product variants (PVs) across all the product stages. Product family architecture (PFA) can perform as a general product structure to capture the commonalities and generalize the differences of the PF members. Based on the rationales of PFA, this paper proposes an extended PF approach to support services in terms of platform, modules, for-services data, resources and knowledge. A complex services system including systematic strategy, generic solution and reusable modules can be formulated on the PF level to serve all the PVs. And a series of services bill-of-material (SBOMs) are employed to manage all related services data and documents such as customer product, quality and dismantling etc.

articleTitle: Price-adjusting contract in supply chain with asymmetric information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Members have asymmetrical information in supply chains. Stable and long-term trade companionship is difficult to set up and maintain without efficient coordination mechanism. Once the supply-demand relation set up, because the demander may misdirect the supplier to grab more profit by information concealing (or information advantage), the supplier will suffer under most situations. This paper designed for the supplier a price-adjusting strategy, which efficiently prevents the demander's speculating behavior and alleviates the "bullwhip effect" in the supply chain.

articleTitle: POS access pricing problem in China - analyze from network economy view
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents a model of a natural monopolistic transfer center providing one-way access to the merchants who could bypass the network with certain cost. We use this model to analyze the event of "merchants in Shenzhen reject bank cards", which is very important to development of POS system and bank transfer center in China. We find the efficient component pricing rule is propriety for this case. We also find the information management level of the merchants and the customer's habit of consumption are closely related to the decision of merchants.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on the forming model of customer loyalty: the case study of mobile communication service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Customer loyalty has been advocated as an easier and more reliable source of superior performance. To improve customer loyalty, firms initiate a variety of activities, including programs on satisfaction and complaint management. However, in understanding the relation between satisfaction and loyalty, the forming mechanism of loyalty has not been explained reasonably in academe, so there are supposes that the formation of loyalty might include other factors except for satisfaction. Through the research methods such as qualitative interview and questionnaire survey, this paper generalized the drivers and their influencing mechanism on loyalty. Based on the previous papers, the paper tries to construct the forming model of customer loyalty. In the case of mobile communication service, it demonstrates the interior relation among satisfaction, relationship trust and switching cost and their influencing mechanism on loyalty, and analyzes the modulating mechanism of the scene factors on loyalty. The conclusions provide reference for the mobile communication corporation to establish customer relationship management strategies.

articleTitle: The study on mechanism of knowledge intensive services in knowledge system: the case of management consultancy
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Though the role of knowledge intensive services in knowledge creation and distribution has been verified, the mechanism of knowledge creation and dissemination in knowledge intensive services has tended to remain elusive. Basing on the approach of knowledge systems and theory of knowledge transferring process, this paper studies the pattern of knowledge creation and dissemination of knowledge intensive services in and between knowledge system, which emphasize the importance of tacit knowledge and culture milieu. According to pattern above, we make an analysis of the roles played by management consultancy firms in and between knowledge systems. Finally, some implications for enhancing capacity of knowledge management in management consultancy firms are discussed.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of urban management and public services in Chinese cities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the rapid urbanization of China, the complexity of urban management increased significantly. Aiming to investigate the development of urban management in typical Chinese cities, the authors interviewed several municipal governments and a comparative study reveals that there exist different patterns of urban management in China now. A further analysis indicates some critical factors influenced the forming of different patterns of urban management.

articleTitle: Interface management in enterprises
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This article combines the following theories: interface management and enterprise's informationization of management, and exposes the relation and interaction of them. Then we expose the thought of interface management included in two common information systems (SRM, CRM). Through above we can know the relation that complements each other between interface management and enterprise's informationization.

articleTitle: Construct exchange value model: toward a dynamic B-to-B relationship marketing theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This research by the value form, the efficiency and the relational viewpoint, theory of critique and the inferential reasoning of the penetration literature, constructs the value in exchange equation. Discovery of and the contribution of the research is: 1. Understood the transaction behavior pattern, and the discovery enterprise penetrates the internal management ability to pass the exchange creation non-economic value to transform the economic value. 2. The complex value in exchange concept, completely presented with the model, and the solid service is able to understand composition essential factor for the value in exchange in order to help the academic circles. 3. Between the penetration value in exchange pattern analytic relationship and the value connection, and the showing relations may enhance the non-economic value to hand over extends the solid ready-made economic value the probability, imply the enterprise to invest relational the importance.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis about the bullwhip effect in supply chain with multi-distribute center
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Based on literature (M. Baganha et al., 1998), applying a quantifying warp undulation method, model of supply chain with multi-distribute center is developed to describe the bullwhip effect. The H/sub /spl infin// control strategies of bullwhip effect are developed. Its essence is that under the worst station of demand variability, make the optimal decision of supply chain management. A simulation of petroleum distribute system is done.

articleTitle: Evolutionary stability of pricing strategies in a retail market with service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper analyzes the evolutionary stability of pricing strategies in a retail market by adopting an indirect evolutionary approach. We consider one population consisting of retailers who randomly compete with each other in pairs. Given their strategies (preferences), retailers rationally choose service level to maximize their utilities. We describe the interaction by a symmetric game and derive the conditions under which the pricing strategies are evolutionary stable. It is shown that the outcome mainly depends on the market scale, the substitutability coefficient of strategic interaction and the corresponding probability of promotional pricing strategy. We present the evolutionary stable strategies, service levels and profits of the retailers by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Research on innovational knowledge platform within a region
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Innovational knowledge plays a more important role in regional innovation, and the rapid popularization of Internet makes it possible to establish a Web-based innovational knowledge market for knowledge sharing and re-creation. The problems are: (1) How to store all kinds of innovational knowledge into repository effectively (for seller); (2) How to retrieve them from the repository expediently (for buyer). In this paper, we propose a scheme to establish an innovational knowledge platform for medicine sector (includes medical treatment instrument) within a region, mainly including the design of innovational knowledge repository. In fact, the research method is also applicable for other sectors.

articleTitle: Implementing customer relationship management in mass customized business
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Customer loyalty and satisfaction with a company's products or services is often seen as the key to a company's success and long-term competitiveness, including mass customized business. While mass customization has already been discussed in the literature for several decades, few paid its attention on how to implement customer relationship management in it. To tell the characteristics of CRM in mass customized business, this paper discusses the requirement proposed by MC to implement CRM, and then gives some suggestions for future research.

articleTitle: Business process modeling based on workflow model reuse
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Workflow is a widespread technology and useful in business processes modeling. It can improve enterprises' competitiveness by increasing productivity and enhancing services for customers. A lot of workflow models have been accumulated in business application. These modeling experience are valuable and hard to acquire, and workflow models are similar in some degree if they are classified according to the business domain. If these models can be reused in practice, then it will improve the quality and efficiency of the modeling. For the goal, this paper proposes the system architecture to reuse the workflow models, and describe the modeling process.

articleTitle: Service quality of travel agents: the case of travel agents in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Travel agents in China have faced difficult times in recent years because of increasing customer demands and internal competition in the industry. A China Consumer Council report (2003) stated that complaints against travel agencies had increased by 10.6% for the year 2002/2003 as compared with the previous year. The purpose of the study was to assess customers' expectations and perceptions of service provided by travel agents, and to explore how the service factors derived from the factor analysis were related to overall customer satisfaction. The results showed that customers' perceptions of service quality fell short of their expectations, with the reliability dimension having the largest gap. Five factors were derived from the factor analysis of 25 service attributes, and the result of factor analysis showed that overall customer satisfaction was related to these five factors.

articleTitle: Research on methodology of document classification based on statistical learning theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Document classification is one of important steps in document mining. With the statistical learning theory, they proposed a kind of machine learning method based on small sample set. This paper presents a kind of classification model for document classification based on statistical learning theory. In this model, we adopt organized vectors as the eigenvector of documents, trains classifier by means of SVM algorithm, and obtain satisfactory experiment results.

articleTitle: Web mining: a key enabler in e-business
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The Web is becoming the apocryphal Vox Populi. There is an ever expanding amount of information "out there". Unfortunately, the morass of sources presents a formidable hurdle to effectively extract information from them. Web mining consists of extracting knowledge from huge volumes of data available in WWW and other Web sources, allowing better business decisions to be taken. Web mining has been coined from information management & retrieval (IM&R) and artificial intelligence (AI). In this paper, it has been shown how Web mining is integrated to the knowledge discovery process, its potential applications, and techniques. Furthermore, an integrated architecture has been presented showing how Web mining can contribute to e-business via the new technologies. Finally, some commercially-available architecture has been presented.

articleTitle: Domestic e-shop comprehensive evaluation research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Applying level analysis method, we established a synthetical evaluation system model of e-shop on Web. Based on this model, we evaluated objectively and systematically the major e-shop products nowadays. This evaluation model is helpful for users to select e-shops, and can promote the development of e-shop products and service on Web.

articleTitle: Research on the improved algorithm of collaboration-supply in supply chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper presents an improved heuristic selection algorithm, which has a better effect compared with those indicated in literature (L. Chunlin et al., 2004), thus simplifying the solution and being easy to be used. An example is used to test the correctness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: The application of benchmarking in China airlines to improve customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The airline industry is forced by the increasing worldwide competition due to the development of economic globalization and technology advancements. With the characteristic of high risk, high technology and high investment, airline industry is confronting fiercer competition introduced by "open sky policy". Customer service is one of the most important processes in airline industry and is recognized as key to the success of business competition. In order to improve customer satisfaction, benchmarking has been used as a useful tool in paper to evaluate airlines' work and find differences among them. Three biggest domestic airline and a foreign airline have been selected and studied as benchmark. Through benchmarking and learning from them, the performance improvement is obtained.

articleTitle: Information technology, service productivity and service quality - the application of information technology based on a company-customer opening production system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: An important characteristic of service sector is that customers participate in service process, and form a so-called opening production system. Thus, a dual company-customer orientation, which gives consideration to both party's inputs and outputs, needs to be built into the application of information technology in services, so that the integrated service productivity could be enhanced, and service quality finally could get improved fundamentally. This is very different from carrying on technical innovations and applications in a closed system of manufacturing. And it is also a breaking point of overcoming "productivity paradox." This paper, taking the interactive service process as its main clue and based on the characteristics of service, discusses the functions of IT in improving service productivity and service quality at each different stages of the interactive process, which will have theoretical directive significance in our country's strategy of energetically developing service sectors in the information economy era.

articleTitle: The study of cluster analysis of pricing of IPO
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The underpricing of initial public offering has been one of the "the new issue puzzles" in the finance. Working out an objective and scientific method to solve this problem has been the goal of academic, authority and underwriters. Based on the unique character of the Chinese stock market, this paper examines the popular models and theories of the pricing of IPO of the world and analyzes their applicability and limitation in practice. Then we puts forward a new way that applies the cluster analysis, one of multistatistic analysis to the pricing of the initial public offering. By empirical analysis, this paper has raised an effective and feasible method to the pricing of IPO. This way can effectively solve the underpricing of IPO and give some insights and understanding to the reform of the pricing of new issues on Chinese security market.

articleTitle: Analysis on effect of overconfidence on principal-agent contract
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Using the expressing methods of overconfidence provided by Daniel, Hirshleifer, Subrahmanyam, Gervais and Odean etc. for reference, under the condition of hypothesizing the agent to be overconfident, this paper researches the mechanism of the agent's overconfident preference affecting on the principal-agent contract by setting up an appropriate mathematical model. The result shows that the principal-agent contract that the agent obtains entire residual return and bears all operating risk and the principal only obtains fixed return corresponding to his fund and does not bear any operating risk is optimal for the principal under the hypothesis condition that the principal does not monitor the agent. Moreover, the fixed return that the principal could obtain is increased in the overconfident level of the agent and decreased in the agent's reservation utility level.

articleTitle: Robust management for equilibrium stabilization in two-firms advertising game
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This brief paper presents an application of multiple-Hamiltonian synthesis to find a robust equilibrium in a two-player advertise game. Here, LPV /spl mu/-synthesis is served for robust control of the local dynamics at Nash equilibrium of advertising game. In the synthesis, every player is assigned with a different Hamiltonian. Compare with single-Hamiltonian approach, this synthesis involves less conservatism in specification and reveals more interaction among players.

articleTitle: Model analysis of business process integration: take Chinese after service industry's endogenous networking as an example
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper studies the phenomena of corporation's subcontracting part of their business when facing indeterminate demands. A model based on the observation of retailer's after service networks in China is presented. By comparing the social service costs between the two arrangements with and without the participation of the third party, we can see that the efficiency of subcontracting additional peak-load businesses lies mainly in complementary effects of workforce, which is scale economics that led to by indeterminacy. The third party's advantage lies in businesses offsetting to each other complimentarily when serving different retailers. As to the welfare an effect of this endogenous reform, our conclusion is that no one loses with the appearance of this kind of organizational form.

articleTitle: A multi-agent based intelligent system for Internet shopping
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The prosperity of electronic commerce has changed the traditional trading behaviors and more and more people are willing to conduct Internet shopping. This paper presents an agent-based shopping system for Internet commerce. The aim of it is to automate shopping process by assisting customers to have commodity information retrieval and comparison in the massive information environment of the Internet. In this system, several information technologies have been used, including intelligent agent, multi-attribute decision model, preference acquiring model and Web application. The system consists of five types of agents that can interact with each other: interface agent, buyer manager, buyer agent, evaluation agent and preference agent. These agents collaborate with each other by the message delivery mechanism and make the whole system works together. The system framework has been built adopting the technology of the software reuse, thus promoting the reuse of each agent component. The results show that it can provide personalized information services and help customers save enormous time for Internet shopping.

articleTitle: Trajectory of consulting firms and the dynamics of the services: comparative perspectives between USA and China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the social division in the era of knowledge economy, consulting industry becomes more and more important. The rich experiences of development path of US consulting firms should be studied in detail in further researches. Although Chinese local consulting firms should insist in the comparative advantages in local milieu, international rules and regulations becomes even more radical in consulting, and the severe situation is, who will help the Chinese local enterprises go abroad? Are there any necessities for mutual learning and any ways for strategic alliances? The authors of the paper try to probe into the future co-existence of US and domestic consulting firms via perspectives between McKinsey & Co. and ZG Wang Strategic Consultancy in regional rail consulting programs of Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta.

articleTitle: Lower and upper bounds for single machine problem with sequence dependent setup to minimize maximum tardiness
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Tardiness is an important measure for customer satisfaction. This paper addresses the lower and upper bounds for the problem of scheduling N jobs on a single machine with due dates, sequence dependent setup times and no preemption where the objective is to minimize the maximum tardiness. Computational experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the lower and upper bounds.

articleTitle: MIPP: a Web-based medical image processing system for stent design and manufacturing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: To develop tools for stent designer to acquire the parameters of diseased vessel to manufacture a patient-specific stent, we have developed a system able to process and visualize three-dimensional (3D) medical data, reconstruct the geometry of arteries of specific patients and export the volume data of them. Medical image processing platform (MIPP) is based on an integrated set of tools, each dedicated to a specific aspect of the data processing and simulation pipeline: image processing and segmentation; 3D geometry reconstruction; and collaborative visualization. The system can also be used for the modern cardiovascular surgeon to study and interpret the constantly increasing amount of information being produced by noninvasive imaging equipment and guide them during the surgery.

articleTitle: A cross-country comparative study on technological & infrastructure factors as the critical growth factors of e-commerce
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper aims to identify the critical growth factors (hereafter called CGFs) that are essential to the development and growth of e-commerce in a country. The paper starts with reviewing and reclassifying factors explicitly examined by prior studies that have never been unified. The technological & infrastructure factors consist of sub factors that are (a) security, (b) the capacity of Internet connection, (c) IT infrastructure, and (d) telecommunication infrastructure. To identify the sub factors related to the growth of EC, we examine pooled data of 21 industrial and 21 developing countries over period from 2000 to 2003. For data analysis, several indicators are examined in terms of both absolute and incremental value in order to investigate the states of the growth of EC at a particular time and across time. The findings show that the technological & infrastructure factors are critical to the emergence of EC at a particular time. When a country is ready for EC at a particular time, the development of and the increase in the technological & infrastructure factors do not promote the growth of EC. This supports the argument that beyond the readiness of country for utilizing e-commerce there are still some non-technological CGFs remain to be investigated in further studies.

articleTitle: The key factors influence customer purchase decision on retail Web site
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Although electronic commerce (e-commerce) has received considerable research attentions these years, little research has examined the effect of e-commerce's Web presentation on retail customer shopping experiences. Based on some customer-oriented factors identified by previous researchers and recent development in technology, a model of the on-line shoppers' purchase decision factors is derived. We conducted a survey to demonstrate the model. The survey was administered to 117 undergraduate and graduate students. Several most important and influential Web sites in China were selected to explore these students' reactions to Web retailer's presentation of "mp3" products and services and to identify Web-site characteristics that contribute to customer satisfaction arising from the Web-based shopping experience. By quantitative analysis of structural equation models (SEM), the research suggested that the ease of navigation, the ease of finding critical information, and the quality of the detailed (such as close-up view photo) provided on their Web sites are key factors influencing customer purchase decision.

articleTitle: EDI data monitoring and analyzing system based on agent
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The booming Internet with extensive applications of e-trade in a distributed environment has necessitated the careful monitoring and analysis of network information. This paper proposes a multi-agent system EDI-MA (electronic data interchange-multi-agent) embedded in each client to monitor and analyze the XML/EDI format data. The paper introduces the architecture of EDI-MA and describes the organizational structures and functions of single agent in detail. This includes the data exchanging agent (DA), the interacting and coordinating agent (CA), and the computing and analyzing agent (TA). Communicating through four kinds of primitive message language, these agents monitor and analyze cooperatively XML/EDI format data based on the request-response cooperation mechanism with the CA's managing. EDI-MA is installed and run in EDI clients automatically and can be configured to achieve different functions. In addition, an application example in mobile phone online ordering is given to show how the system should perform. This technology can be widely used in the monitoring of electronic tax document and electronic checks on network.

articleTitle: A system dynamics-based study on rivalry in tele-mobile service industry of China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The current mobile service in China displays a highly dynamic competition between two major operators, China Mobile and China Unicom. Most current researches focus on direct comparisons of the relative advantages, weights of which are chosen statically and dynamic relationships between the items compared are usually ignored. This research stands from the view of China Mobile, the bigger and earlier operator, to explore the reason of its shrinking market share after SMS (short message service) becomes popular in China. The dynamics in the service quality, exchange capacity, price are highlighted to show how these factors influence the growth of the whole mobile market and the relative advantage in the competition as well. Long run and short run effects of these factors are differentiated so as to make it possible to suggest some proper policies for China Mobile to sustain the market leadership.

articleTitle: Toward global Internet services to defend against DDoS by dynamic possibility-based packets marking trace back
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: DDoS is harmful to the Internet services for its attacking results, such as the service discontinuity, degradation of the quality of service and traffics aggregation. In this paper we give a dynamic possibility-based packet marking scheme for the IP trace back. In this scheme, packets are marked with the different address information, such as AS number or IP address, and together, with the different possibility according to the traffics loads in the router, which does not result in much performance cost. This scheme can help to the attacking path reconstruction, which helps to the traffics filter, traffics analysis, defense of aggregation and network forensics.

articleTitle: Seaport service efficiency, maritime shipping cost and trade growth of China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Recent economic booming of China is strongly relied on the rapid growth of foreign trade with the world. Historically, continuous artificial trade barriers' recession greatly enhance the importance of shipping cost as a determinant of trade growth. Through the utilization of a standard reduced form approach, this paper develops an empirical analysis of the effect of seaport efficiency on the maritime shipping cost of the China, moreover, the main factors influencing seaport efficiency is demonstrated. Followed these results, a set of maritime shipping cost indexes is constructed to explain the bilateral trade performance of China.

articleTitle: Research on algorithm of design object decomposition in product develop chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The literature of product development chain is reviewed and the problem of design object decomposition in product develop chain is put forward. Based on that, the algorithm of design object decomposition (DODA) is presented and discussed in detail. Finally, a simple illustration of DODA system is described. This research provides the basis for further work in the important area of product development chain.

articleTitle: The study on the two characters in a kind of Markov chain's CRM model
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Based on a previous study, the paper focuses on finding the two characters in a type of Markov chain transition matrix, which is using in describing a customer relationship management (CRM) model for a sales targeted application. The study demonstrates the inner characters of this type of model-variable structure characters and its LU decomposed result.

articleTitle: A data mining approach to performance measurement in the banking industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Performance management (PM) becomes one of the most important initiatives in bank management today. One urgent problem for banks is how to link up employee performance to bank profitability so that resources can be optimally allocated and fully utilized to meet competition and support increasing demand of quality products/services from customers. Mining customer data to measure "productivity" and enhance "performance management" is not only feasible in this information era but also in line with the transformation of a bank into a "customer driven organization". In this article, we propose a data mining approach to performance management in the banking industry.

articleTitle: Why consumer characteristics have an impact on attitude
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: As an ever growing distribution channel for services, the Internet is becoming a potential competitive advantage for providers of services. While success can give access to a large number of online shoppers, the amount of service failures are extensive. Finding the key to provide service excellence on the Internet can make the difference between success and failure to the provider. This article maps the determinants of attitude towards online providers. It distinguishes three kinds of service provider characteristics: "usefulness", "ease of use" and "enjoyment", and how they affect consumer's attitude towards the provider. One of the contributions to the technology acceptance model by Davis et al (1989), is the introduction of consumers' cognitive processing as a moderating variable, and the use of "consumer characteristics" and "online shopping experience" as determinants for "cognitive processing".

articleTitle: IT service management by projects: grid-based organization structure establishment and evolution
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In the management of IT service, which needs knowledge-personnel to work on, human is a kind of scarce resource, which must be effectively allocated. And because IT service is knowledge-intensive, IT service sectors and/or companies need an excellent internal mechanism to self-optimize, and dynamically evolve along with the changes of circumstances. This paper proposes a novel grid-based project management organization structure to allocate human resource effectively, and illustrates its co-evolutionary mechanism from the perspective of ecology.

articleTitle: Web services and virtual communities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With escalating need for global and flexible interactions in increasingly networked society, virtual communities as a new model are becoming important for virtual communication and collaboration. From a technical perspective, the communicative and collaborative functionalities of virtual communities mostly consist of standard components, modules, and tools. These software components and functionalities increasingly come in a form of Web services discovered and invoked via the Internet. This article discusses what Web services are, why Web services are important, and where they are going. In addition, we are also going to look at Web service architecture, standards, advantages, development platforms, and semantic Web.
