This method needs no more special information about the input signal except that it should be band limited to the Nyquist frequency for the whole ADC system. Then the compensation can be working while the ADCs are still running. Here we adopt the genetic algorithm to optimize the initial weight value in the network, this algorithm makes complementary advantages for combining back propagation and genetic algorithms. The compensation method has been validated with simulations from a time interleaved ADC system.

articleTitle: A means of business processing reengineering for the supply chain of service systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Business processing reengineering and optimizing for supply chain of service systems is an important foundation of enhancing the operational efficiency and improving the service quality. The grammatical approach has advantages in describing the processing operation and supporting the processing reengineering obviously. By using the existed grammatical approaches of processing describing for reference and combining the characteristics of supply chain of service systems, we put forward a grammatical model of business processing reengineering for the supply chain of service systems in this paper. Meanwhile, this model offers a scientific and systemic tool of solving problems for the implement of BPR in service systems. In addition, in order to exam the validity and maneuverability of this model, we analyze and reengineer the processes of supermarkets by it.

articleTitle: An integrated method for supplier selection in SCM
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Supplier selection is a multicriteria problem which multiattributions of the suppliers should be considered in SCM (supply chain management). This paper proposes a combination of AHP (analytical hierarchy process) with DEA (data envelopment analysis) to determine the integrated weight for the evaluation criteria of supplier so as to make up for the inconsistent judgments which the AHP is liable to decision-maker and also to solve the problem that the DEA cannot reflect well the preference of decision makers. The proposed methodology features both the merits of the algorithmic and procedural supplier selection approaches. It innovatively solves a supplier selection problem by utilizing both AHP and DEA procedures. A practical case study illustrates its efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Competitive decentralized distribution channels with the move sequence
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We consider the decentralized distribution channel (DDC) in which manufacturers sell differentiated products to the retailers at wholesale prices and the retailers choose the retail prices. We consider the move sequence in the two-level supply chain, which is applied to both the case of determinate demand (Case I) and that of stochastic demand (Case II). In this setting, we show that it is the second-mover advantage in our Case I and the first-mover advantage in Case II, while the total supply chain performance will be better off in Case I. Furthermore, we compare these results with those from Trivedi (1998).

articleTitle: A research of deposit insurance mechanism overcoming moral hazard
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Though the deposit insurance system increases the stability of banking system by averting bank-runs, but it increases the instability of banking system instead because the depositors reduce the market discipline on the bank and the bank has the incentive of risk-taking excessively, this is so-called moral hazard. This paper designs an optimal deposit insurance mechanism overcoming the bank's moral hazard by utilizing the theory and methodology of mechanism designing. The study shows that there exists an optimal deposit insurance mechanism satisfying the incentive compatible conditions to overcome the bank's moral hazard in the deposit insurance market with asymmetrical information, however, compared to the deposit insurance mechanism under symmetrical information, both the deposit insurance coverage and the deposit insurance premium rate decrease.

articleTitle: Employee job performance: an exchange view
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Relationship between the construct of task performance and non-task performance is a interesting topic in human resource management and the construct of non-task performance has further developed on the construct of performance. Within the past 100 years, several studies have used the OCB, PCB, extra-role behavior, personality and trait to clarify and delineate the construct of non-task performance. This paper introduces several different theories and assumptions on the relationship between the construct of task performance and non-task performance, and points out some problems existing in these studies. Based on the previous studies, we suggest our own model on the construct of task performance and non-task performance.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid intelligent maintenance system and its application
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In order to improve productivity and global competitiveness, a novel equipment maintenance method, hybrid intelligent maintenance system (HIMS), is proposed. HIMS's key challenge is how to integrate and combine some intelligent methods, make use of their merits and avoid their demerits to forecast the incipient fault efficiently, and to prevent the fault from further deterioration. Inspired by "divide and conquer" and "learn strong points to offset weakness", we try to simplify the complicated equipment maintenance task by decomposing the work into two subsystems: hybrid intelligent fault diagnosis system and hybrid intelligent condition forecasting system based on advanced signal processing and artificial intelligence methods. The HIMS is applied to the maintenance of the turbo-generator set in a power plant, and the simulated results show that the proposed method is very effective.

articleTitle: Modeling retail performance using consumer panel data: a Shanghai case study
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Policy-makers and retailers are keenly watching and debating developments in Chinese retailing. As a contribution to the debate we present a method for investigating retail performance. Our focus is on sales performance and the components of performance in the context of store-type patronage (e.g., the number of customers patronizing hypermarkets, supermarkets, small grocers, convenience stores, wet markets and street vendors to buy frequently-bought goods). We report an analysis of consumer panel data collected from 471 Shanghai households during 2004. For mineral water (a Western product) and dried noodles (a more traditional Chinese product) we show there are regular patterns of store-type patronage, most of which are predictable from the NBD-Dirichlet model. These predictions enable retail performance to be assessed. Deviations are apparent too (e.g., that patronage of wet markets and small grocers for dried noodle purchasing is somewhat anomalous, whereas this is not evident for mineral water purchasing).

articleTitle: Study on process capability indices (PCI) for mass customization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Mass customization is a kind of fine-new production mode that corporations make individual customization for every customer's requirements by advanced technologies and managerial methods while the costs and time are the same as the volume-production. This paper analyzes the conception and characters of mass customization. And it reviews the current research of process capability indices (PCI) of variety-and-batch production home and abroad. Volume-production and mass customization are compared in the paper. On the basis of discussion of the point estimates and lower confidence limits of SPC, it brings forward the method to fix on PCI of mass customization.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of the picking up medicine queuing system for a medical warehouse - a case study of Shenzhen Jianhua Medical Company
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper, based on the warehouse operations of Shenzhen Jianhua Medical company, describes the elements of the picking up medicine queueing system, identifies the characteristics of the probability distribution of customer interarrival times and service times, determines which queueing model is most appropriate for the Jianhua company, applies M/Ms model and M/M/s nonpreemptive priorities model to obtain the key measures of performance for this queueing system, applies economic analysis to decide how many servers should be provided to minimize the total cost, and gives the optimal design to improve the behavior of the warehouse operations for Jianhua Company.

articleTitle: Analysis of extra cost for small suppliers under VMI condition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The original idea of the vendor managed inventory (VMI) is to reduce the stock cost considerably and get rid of "bull-whip effect" for the whole supply chain. However, it is common that the small supplier is always being oppressed by the big manufacturers because of the difference of strength between them. In this article, the extra cost for the small supplier which is one member of supply chain have been analyzed and the relative factors which support the extra cost have been calculated either.

articleTitle: Fuzzy integration method of synthetic evaluation for supplier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper introduces the fuzzy integration method of synthetic evaluation for supplier. The proposed method is an extension of the Lebesgue integration method, expands the usable area of the integration method in synthetic evaluation. We give an example to validate its practicability. In addition, we raise an idea of the approximate objective synthetic evaluation in terms of group synthetic evaluation of systems, so that we can reduce the influence of subjective biases in synthetic evaluation and make synthetic evaluation closer to the objective reality.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of the relationship between the market response of the SEOs and the growth opportunity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: After calculating the average abnormal returns near the information releasing date to new equity issues, using a sample of 47 announcements made during the period 2000-2002 by the event study method, this paper found that the stock market response negatively to such news. Evidence shows that the correlation between the abnormal returns and the growth opportunities proxied for by accounting growth are negative before the announcement year of the new equity issues, the correlation between the abnormal returns and the net income growth rate are positive at the year of announcement to new equity issues but are negative at the next year.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation of the performance of workflow interoperability system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Based on IOWF, timed factors are introduced in the paper, and the different communication relationships between local workflows are described with Petri net employed. Timed interorganizational workflow model is established finally so as to put forward approaches to solve the question on evaluation of workflow interoperability system.

articleTitle: The effect of electronic commerce initiatives on firm performance: an empirical research on Chinese IT listed companies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Influence of the electronic commerce initiatives on firm performance has always been a hot and important subject in the e-commerce field. This paper focuses on the empirical research of the effect of the e-commerce initiatives on firm performance, with data from 64 Chinese listed companies in the IT industry. The results showed that e-commerce tends to be associated with the increased revenue, improved company efficiency, and increased cost of goods sold, with a positive relation between the e-commerce and the integrated firm performance.

articleTitle: Cargo mix and shipment planning problem with uncertainty
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: International ocean container shipping is a huge investment business and carriers expect more benefits from improving the operational level cargo mix and shipment planning. In this paper, we describe the characteristics of the cargo mix and shipment schedule problem with uncertainty in a multi-period planning horizon, and propose a two-stage stochastic mixed integer programming model for the problem. The objective of the model is maximizing the expected profit over the possible decisions under the uncertainty of shipping capacities. A heuristic algorithm is proposed to obtain an approximate optimal solution for the problem. Finally, we give numerical experiments to demonstrate the efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The research of strategic client manager competence model of telecommunication industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper defines the competence characteristics as "a latent and lasting individual behavioral characteristics that separate the ordinary performer with the outstanding ones to ensure the dimensions of competence and outward behavior of client managers". Based on this, it explores the competence characteristics conceptual model of strategic client managers of telecommunication industry. It adopts the multi-order layered dimensional design (threshold characteristics, matching characteristics, development characteristics) and establishes a three-dimensional solid competence characteristics model; moreover, using the structural equation model, it conducts an empirical research to the samples of strategic client managers of Jiangsu Mobile Company and tests the proposed conceptual model.

articleTitle: An ambulatory monitoring architecture for the remote healthcare service system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The design of a smart sensor to monitor physical and physiological activity is discussed in terms of its integration within an intelligent telecare system. The proposed device measures posture, gait, and movement transition by three accelerometers. A physiological vibration sensor is used to monitor blood pressure and pulse rate, which is also clinically important parameters. The device detects a fall and monitors the status of the faller to identify whether assistance is required. The device also provides a measure of mobility which may be utilized in the automatic calculation of the activities of daily living, for use by some patients, social workers and occupational therapists as well for continuously determining a person's ability to live independently in the community. A data processing schema in which these parameters are extracted is described. It is hoped that such a device promotes an integrated approach to the management of patients with chronic diseases including CHF (congestive heart failure), brain blood vessel and et al, and the management of falls by the elderly in the community.

articleTitle: Behavior change tactics of the social marketing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In China, the implementation of social marketing is on the preliminary stage. The social marketing projects involve wide range of knowledge, lasts for a long period, and the success rate is low. The main reason is lack of an effective tactics, which could be used to change the target group's behavior continuously and perennially. The paper discusses how to make tactics of the social marketing. Firstly, looking into the meaning of the social marketing, the behavior change factors system base on the behavior model of Kurt Lu was proposed, and the target group behavior change tactics under the social marketing was set up according to it. Finally, the paper suggested the basic principles of the application the behavior change tactics.

articleTitle: Three unequal period inventory models with cost changes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: There have been extensive discussions in the literature for possible extension of the basic economic order quantity (EOQ) model under various situations where the original assumptions are slack. This paper is concerned with three unequal period inventory models with cost increases, which has not been adequately addressed yet. We provide four possible types of the structure of the optimal policy and develop short procedures for determining optimal ordering policy. Our method developed in this paper provides a way to investigate the classical EOQ model for possible extension.

articleTitle: Advanced manufacturing technology, quality of product and level of performance: empirical evidence from Chongqing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: To be successful in this globally competitive and rapid changing environment, organization must formulate strategic plans that are consistent with their investment in and use of manufacturing technology. This study proposes that organizations invest in advanced manufacturing technology will have improved quality of product and better performance than those do not. In order to verify these arguments, the survey based on questionnaires was widely employed in this paper. Chongqing manufacturing industry was selected to be the population of samples. Empirical results with the help of structural equation modeling and its tool - AMOS show that the relationships between a firm's practices in the areas of AMT and quality are statistically significant and positive. Also, high level of quality leads to high level of performance.

articleTitle: Data mining techniques of common information platform based on ATMS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper discusses the data mining techniques of common information platform based on ATMS (advanced traffic management system). We divide the content into four parts: firstly, we define the conception and function of ATMS; secondly, we suggest the function and framework of common information platform based on ATMS; thirdly, we study the data mining techniques of common information platform based on ATMS; lastly, we argue simulation results and analysis of data mining.

articleTitle: An empirical study on online China journal service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: According to a survey and further study, three main service providers, named CNKI, Wanfang Data Co. and Chongqing VIP Information Co,, currently dominate the online China journal market They offer access to "China academic journal", "Digital journals group of China" and "Database of scientific and technologic journals in Chinese" databases respectively. As a result, these three oligarchs compete with one another. Their characteristics and strategies are analyzed by applying the game theory. Their sales revenue has been on steady increase over the past years. Today, they are looking at new opportunities to market their huge deal of journal data and other information resources on a larger scale. But when comparing with world-class tycoon in the field, such as Dialog, OCLC, Elsevier Science Direct Online, these three companies and all other Chinese service providers in the field still have a long way to go.

articleTitle: Optimal order policies for supply chain with options contracts
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We consider two independent retailers that face stochastic demand. Because of long lead-time and short selling season, retailers obtain goods from a supplier via options contract. At the beginning of the selling season, retailer can adjust their positions by trading options with another when the demand is realized. We focus on deriving how the possibility of such options trading between two independent retailers affects each retailer's optimal order and optimal profit. Game theory is adopted as an analysis tool. We show that there exists a unique Nash equilibrium in pure strategy for retailers' optimal orders with options trading. The retailer's optimal profit with options trading is higher than the case without options trading. The retailers' optimal orders with options trading all increase in options trading price. There exists a unique optimal options price that yields the retailers' joint optimal profit.

articleTitle: Developed nations financial support and risk investment of technology innovation: institutional frame and comparison
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper has discussed and stated the background and institutional modes under which financial support and risk investment institutional frames appeared in the system of technology innovation achievement industrialization promote systems of USA, Japan and Europe Union. It also has analyzed and compared characteristics of these three developed economies' technology innovation achievement industrialization support modes, and in allusion to existent problems in financial support and risk investment institutional aspects of China such industrialization, set out corresponding policy measure.

articleTitle: Applying grey relational analysis to the improvement of the quality of ISP customer service - an example of ADSL
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: People rely on the Internet in a higher and higher degree. Life, work, career, socializing, recreation and amusement are all closely bound up with the network. When wide-band networks are created, the demands of users on the networks became more and more versatile. Hence, how to improve the quality of customer service might be an important topic for the Internet service provider (ISP). The main aims of this paper are to observe customers' responses to the wide-band service that ISPs offer, and apply grey relational analysis to analyze the factors which influence the satisfaction of customers. Empirical data in the ChiTelcom Company from September of 2003 to August of 2004 are taken as sample. Among these available items, ten service factors are extracted to evaluate the service quality level of an ISP with ADSL in the wide-band network environment. Aside from the factor "ADSL network breakdown", the results show that "expenses arrearage" is the key factor influencing customer satisfaction. Still, suggestion and conclusion are also proposed improving the quality of service and increasing competitiveness in the ISP industry.

articleTitle: Research on CI meta-synthetic framework in CI service industries
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper discusses CI meta-synthetic framework based on the principles of meta-synthetic from quantitative to qualitative after detailed analysis of the complexities of CI, including the flow of CI meta-synthetic, CI qualitative synthesization based on classical Delphi and its improvement, and the realization of CI meta-synthetic. We point out that CI meta-synthetic framework is an important and effective methodology for CI researches so that the CI service industries can use this systematic framework for reference and provide efficient CI products and services for the customers.

articleTitle: Optimized allocation of resources based on neural dynamic system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The allocation of resources is an important question in the domain of services trade. Usually, in order to get a better allocating form, a great deal of computing price has to be paid. And also, because of the complexity of the computing, an optimized allocating form is unable to be acquired frequently in fact. A method of optimized allocation of resources is presented in this paper. It's based on the neural dynamic system. Via this way, the optimized allocating form is generated fully dynamically and there's no need to enumerate all kinds of allocating forms. The computing efficiency is improved quite greatly. At the same time, the neural dynamic system can be processed with thread technology. Cells in each group are able to function concurrently. Thus, the calculating speed is increased more.

articleTitle: Impact of industrial competitive characteristic on firms' debt financing decision: evidence from China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Study on debt financing decision of firms in different competitive forms by a dynamic empirical model, includes how to decide the capital structure and the decision between debt financing and equity financing. Result shows that there is important linkage between debt financing decision and industrial competitive characteristic, and when deciding debt financing, completely competitive firms are more rational than monopoly ones.

articleTitle: Production strategy in supply chain under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In this paper production strategies in supply chain under different information conditions, specially under asymmetry information, are discussed. Cost and profit function both of producer and stock keeper is developed, where producer is principal and stock-keeper is agent. Under asymmetry information the individual rationality constraint of producer's least profit is transformed into quadric form function, and through making the first order condition of stock-keeper's profit for the parameter of storage cost as state equation and applying maximal principle, production strategy with asymmetry information is deduced. The difference of production strategies under different information conditions is analyzed and simulation is done.

articleTitle: New path of intellectual capital value increasing in the knowledge-based enterprise
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Concerning the research of intellectual capital value increasing, Thomas A. Stewart and Dave Ulrich, two American scholars, have put forward their theories. Based on the comparing of the advantages and disadvantages of the two theories, this article brought forward the "5-E" model which help analyze the knowledge-based enterprise, analyze its contents and some practical problems we must pay attention to.

articleTitle: Impact of organization-service provider-customer relationships on the display of positive emotions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Integrating organizational behavior literature and marketing literature on the interaction among three components in service deliveries: organization, service provider and customer, the present study discussed the antecedents and consequences of service provider's display of positive emotions when the interactions among organization, service provider and customer are taken into account. Adopting a role theoretic perspective, it is proposed that service provider's role conflict is negatively related to his/her display of positive emotions during the service delivery which, in turn is positively related to customer's satisfaction with the service provider. Moreover, it is proposed that customer's satisfaction of service provider and customer's overall satisfaction on the organization is positively related, moderated by customer-organization relationship. By focusing on the interaction among three components, the present study extended previous research on the antecedents and consequences of service provider's display of positive emotions.

articleTitle: Term structure of China's short term interest rate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Short term interest rate is the most important price in currency market to capture the dynamics of China's short term interest rate. This paper puts up a basic model of term structure for China's interbank offered rate. We proposed several hypotheses for the main parameters of the basis model and applied time series models to empirically study the term structure of China's interbank offered rate. We found that the term structure of China's short term interest rate has persistent volatility and the drift error term has apparent asymmetry.

articleTitle: Discussions on application of franchise in Chinese vocational education industry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Vocational education industry, a promising industry, is still in its initial stage in applying franchise in China, and there are some problems need to be solved. In this paper, the present state of IT education industry in China is analyzed and a few countermeasures based on core competence view are proposed here in order to help vocational education companies gain sustainable competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain coordination under different risk attitude portfolios of the agents
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We extend the issue of supply chain coordination with risk attitude agents. The different risk partial agents are defined firstly, and then we built the benchmark models, which can coordinate the supply chain according to the Pareto-optimality criterion. Based on the various risk attitude portfolio of the enterprise, different supply chain coordination cases are set up, and in each case we show how we can find the set of Pareto-optimal solutions. Furthermore, numerical analyses are carried out in order to verify the supply chain coordination mathematics models. The future research is discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Factors affecting IT adoption: the case of a Chinese retail company
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Chinese retail companies are facing fierce competition because of entry of WTO. Information technologies can reinforce the competitive ability for retail companies. This study tries to find out state of IT adoption and factors that affect IT adoption in Chinese retail companies. All the factors that greatly influence the IT adoption in retail companies were listed. A big Chinese retail company's IT adoption was studied as a case. Some special factors are given out that may be helpful for IT adoption of Chinese retail companies.

articleTitle: Research on mathematical model for automatic summarization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Automatic summarization is need of the era. The definitions, features, functions and classifications of summary are discussed in the paper. The problem of automatic summarization is described using a mathematic method and the solution is proposed. The solution makes use of meta-knowledge to describe the composition of the summary and help to calculate the semantic distance between summary and source document. According to these, the mathematical model of automatic summarization is established. It is concluded that the best summary is the summary that has the minimum sum of all the meta-knowledge weight among all the summaries. It is proposed that how to get meta-knowledge aggregate and their weight are the key problems in the model. There is also a discussion of how to select output from all the best summaries in the paper. The mathematic description of automatic summarization will be useful for the application of automatic summarization and the summary quality assessment.

articleTitle: Defining and measuring quality in public areas
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The issue of quality of service is becoming increasingly important in the public area as a result of new public management reform. This paper mainly discusses on defining and measuring quality in public areas. The content includes explaining the changing quality concepts in the public areas, selecting the right quality measures and indicators and involving the right stakeholders during the measuring process.

articleTitle: Study on scheme of agent compensation and quality of service
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Agent is a populous phenomenon in economy system today no matter in industry sectors and in services sectors. Agent has become an efficient method to enlarge business for many enterprises in service sectors, for example Mcdonald's. But how to encourage the agent improving the quality of service as demanded by the firm is an impotent problem. After all the agent keep in touch with customers directly instead of firm, the quality of service offered by the agent affect the impression of the firm among customers. In some extent this is a kind of principle-agent problem. In this study we develop a principle-agent to explain the relationship between the compensation scheme offered by firm and the incentive of agent to improve the quality of service. We find the when the effort can be perceived the agent refers to the fixed compensation. When the effort cannot be perceived, the agent inclines to decrease the level of effort. But when the cooperation happens in more than one period, the agent considers the effect of reputation and refers to take effort to improve the quality of service.

articleTitle: Revision of the observed data based on neural networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: It is a very important task for graduation of the observed data in composing the mortality table. Currently, there are different limitations influencing the methods of graduation. In this paper, the revision of data is completed by means of neural networks. This paper mainly uses a three -to -eight -to -one's model of neural network for graduation of the observed data. As it is illustrated in the paper, the method is right, and can be generalized to the graduation of observed data of other schemes.

articleTitle: A decision support model based on GIS for vehicle routing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Aim at resolving the problems of how to route and schedule vehicles in a business logistics system where vehicles deliver products starting from and ending at a central depot to multiple retailers, a decision support model based on GIS, in which a two-phase heuristic algorithm is applied to route and schedule vehicles according to the different types of planning problems, is developed to minimize transportation costs for product delivery in this paper. A case for vehicle routing is solved by this decision support mode and the results shows that the suggested heuristic algorithm gives near optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Government, society and individual effects on health care expenditure
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Based on the demand function, this paper analyzes the relationship among the government, society and individual health expenditures and the income of the government, society and individual, using the co-integration theory. It is found that there exists unique long-run relationship among the government, society and individual health expenditures and the income of the government, society and individual in the model over the sample period. It is also found that health care is a kind of necessity to the government and society. Income elasticity of demand of government is near to 1 and larger than the societies'. Health care is a kind of luxury to the individual. The result shows that we can not conclude that disburse of government in health care decreases during the period. It is rational of the decrease of the scale of society health care expenditure to the total health care expenditure and the increase of the scale of the individual health care expenditure to the total health care expenditure.

articleTitle: Service marketing researches of China in the past 10 years: brief review and future research directions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the status quo, characteristics, problems and future research directions of China's service marketing researches. Firstly, with the keyword 'services marketing', a total of 287 articles covering the time period 1994 to 2004 are searched in CNKI and VIP databases. Secondly, through the analysis of literatures, the authors point out that the increase of service marketing articles and the change of research fields are correlated with the development of service industries and their system reforms. Thirdly, three problems and corresponding research directions are suggested. In future researches, we need to (1) increase quantitative and positive researches; (2) analyze the service consumption psychology and behavior of China's consumers; (3) discuss service marketing countermeasures according to the characteristics of different industries.

articleTitle: Inter-organizational business process modeling for electronic commerce based on pi-calculus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Electronic commerce on the Internet has become exceedingly dynamic and inter-organizational in recent times. Interorganizational workflow management system has become an important paradigm for business-to-business electronic commerce applications. The modeling of interorganizational business processes is a challenging task, due to the high degree of autonomy and heterogeneity of the cooperative organizations. A number of standardization initiatives are working on standards for modeling languages that can be employed under interorganizational environments. This paper presents a formal specification methodology for interorganizational workflow modeling which is founded upon the pi-calculus process algebra. This method works well for characterizing the behaviors and interactions of the workflow processes that belong to different organizations in terms of the semantics of pi-calculus. Experimental results show that the proposed method works well for the modeling of electronic commerce systems under interorganizational environments.

articleTitle: The valuation of compound options on jump-diffusions with time-dependent parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In a recent paper, Chandrasekhar ReddyGukhal (2004) derived analytical valuation formulas for compound options when the underlying asset follows a jump-diffusion process. The parameters (interest rate, volatility and dividend rate) in the model are constant. In reality, however, these parameters change with time. In this paper a generalization of compound options formulas on jump-diffusions is derived in the case of time-dependent parameters. Such a generalization seems to be more appropriate for the valuation of compound options.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the external influencing factors for consumers'adopting electronic payment platform [consumers'adopting electronic payment platform read as consumers' adoption of electronic payment platform]
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: An empirical study on the external influencing factors for consumers' adoption of electronic payment platform is performed. As a result, 12 external factors which effect on consumers' adoption of electronic payment platform were found by factor analysis method. By the filtration of the logistic regression equation, four factors, i.e. the consumers' economic conditions, external force, experience of unconventional shopping and expectation of saving, are proved to significantly effect on consumers' adoption of electronic payment platform. Finally, according to the results with logistic regression, some marketing strategies are put forward to improve the marketing performance of the electronic payment platform.

articleTitle: A user-friendly adaptive dynamic financial analysis system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This study is intended to assist property-casualty insurers in modeling their dynamic financial analysis (DFA) system. Moreover, we address the important steps and considerations that go into a user-friendly adaptive decision support system with which the modeler is capable of easily refining the associated models of risk factors through a series of GUIs with as much work as possible left to the computer system.

articleTitle: Collaborative standards development and adoption with network externalities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We study industry-based collaborative standard development and adoption by firms in a consortium setting, when the standard is open and free. We present a game-theoretical model that recognizes the fact that 1) firm's decision to develop or adopt is endogenous, e.g. firms only participate in the development if doing so dominates being a passive adopter of the standard or not adopting at all; 2) the standard is jointly developed by all participating firms; 3) the standard adoption has network externalities, i.e. the more firms use the standard, the more valuable it is to all adopters; 4) developing firms have insider benefit based on their involvement in the standardization, which results in lower adoption cost. We find that 1) no firm want to be a passive adopter if there is no benefit of waiting in adoption; 2) when the benefit of waiting is lower than a threshold, there are no passive adopters and 3) developing firm's contribution is not a function of the network externalities.

articleTitle: Supply chain contract under product cost disruption
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Supply chain contracts, as the effective supply chain coordination mechanism, have been extensively investigated in the literature under the stationary setting. We consider a supply chain involving one supplier and one retailer in which a revenue-sharing contract is adopted. Though the supply chain can obtain coordination under the stationary setting using this contract, but emergent and unforeseeable accidents maybe occur, its effects make the supplier's production cost fluctuate, further, the supply chain's coordination status maybe be broken off. We give the supply chain's optimal emergency strategy and propose adjusted revenue-sharing contracts to coordinate the supply chain under the cost disruptions based on the consideration that the supply chain contract mechanisms coordinate the supply chain must consider the effects of risk pooling, especially the risk incurred from the uncertainty of emergent and unforeseeable accidents.

articleTitle: Incentives for information sharing across branches in e-government
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The information bulwark occurring across the branches is the main obstacle that baffles e-government's realization, and therefore, it is necessary how to encourage the information sharing across the branches in e-government institutionally. As a resolvent of the problem above, the incentives model were established when information sharing occurred among the governmental branches. The author thought that the positive incentives and the negative one must be adopted simultaneously because of their mutual assurance relationship in order to impel the information sharing among the governmental branches.

articleTitle: Optimal model of anti-dumping duty rate under Cournot competition between similar products
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: At first, according to the relevant economic theories, the author points out the disadvantages of the formula of dumping margin on which the antidumping (AD) duty rate depends, which is used by WTO and our domestic government. Then the author concludes the optimal model of working out antidumping duty rate under Cournot competition between different products. At last, the author analyses the factors impacting antidumping duty rate, meanwhile provides our government some suggestions on determining antidumping duty rate and gives the domestic firms some advices during investigation cases.

articleTitle: Co-evolution of agents in self-organized criticality
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Evolutionary computation has been applied successfully in evolutionary multi-agent system (MAS) design in electronic commerce (EC). Studies of evolutionary MAS are mainly fastened on "fastest find the fittest steady state" now. This is not adaptive or suitable when the problem goes much complicated or rapidly changing. This paper describes the analysis of studies in software evolution, especially of MAS, presents a united evolutionary model, proves reality system, information or software system and knowledge system are united in self-organized criticality state, and discusses the co-evolution rules of agents in self-organized criticality. This model covers the following features: the co-evolution agents for self-organizing and self-adaptive multi-agent systems, the united multi-agent system for reality system and knowledge management, and the dynamic information creation in self-organized criticality.

articleTitle: A study on development level of communication industry in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of factor analysis in multianalysis statistics so as to identify the development level of communication industry in China. It analyzes the statistics data of 2004 in the communication industry, and its purpose is to provide a thinking and research way to evaluate the development level of communication industry. And it tries to provide a decision reference for improving development ability of communication industry, and for enhancing mechanism reform force in this field.

articleTitle: Analysis of moment invariant's stability to gray-level adjustment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Moments can uniquely describe an image. Moment invariants with stability to geometric transformation can be used as features to recognize images despite geometric transformations. However, moment invariants lose stability when gray-levels are adjusted. Usually image processing may cause adjusting of gray-level, which limits application of moment invariants. This paper analyses the relation between invariant moments and gray-level adjustment, and concludes that gray-level histogram equalization can enhance the stability of invariant moments effectively. The conclusion is well proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance technology criterion on communication, toll and monitoring systems of expressway in Jiangsu province
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The criterion fills a vacancy in the maintenance technology criterion on the expressway of Jiangsu province, China. As a guide of the criterion, this paper introduces the significance and compiling requirements of the criterion, and then helps the executants to catch on the main contents, rationale, hierarchy and inherent relations of the six subcriterions with graphs.

articleTitle: A framework for e-commerce data exchange service of B2B and B2C with XML embedded documents
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The data exchange process is very important to establish the B2B and B2C e-commerce business. This paper proposed a framework for e-commerce data exchanging service based on XML embedded documents. The service can be used to exchange the e-commerce data between the customers and the special B2B and B2C e-commerce management information systems. The framework is consisted of the client side and the server side. In the client side, the e-commerce data is embedded into XML embedded documents and delivered to the B2B and B2C e-commerce management information systems. In the server side, the XML embedded documents received from the client are transformed to the e-commerce data items that can be recognized by the B2B and B2C e-commerce management information systems. It offered a convenient data exchange service for B2B and B2C e-commerce that is suitable for large-scale customers to exchange e-commerce data asynchronously with low cost, extensive information treatment.

articleTitle: Research of import iron ore logistics system based on the minimum cost theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Although it has become the mainstay properties of world economy, the development of the logistics industry is now out of balance: there are very few cases that have succeeded when referring to the transportation and distribution of bulk cargo. The paper presents a thorough research on iron ore logistics centering ports that act as active players in the supply chain, and builds up an order-transportation-inventory system with multi-suppliers and multi-users. Then a mathematical model is established to analyse an optimal logistic system to achieve minimum integrated circulating cost with full consideration of the profits of ports, carriers and shippers, by which the authors hope to provide a practical way for the development of the domestic iron ore logistics.

articleTitle: A generalized particle model for social coordination and autonomy in MAS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS), every autonomous agent tries to increase its own personal utility under complex environment involving a variety of types of social coordination. Modeling the social coordination and autonomy of agents is of great significance for distributed problem-solving in MAS. This paper is devoted to a novel generalized particle approach to model social coordination and autonomy in MAS. At first, we analyze and formalize some typical types of social coordination in MAS. Then we discuss the generalized particle model (GPM) for distributed problem-solving in MAS that is related to social coordination and social dynamics. Finally, we demonstrate the GPM-based parallel algorithm and its properties for parallel distributed task allocation and resource assignment in MAS.

articleTitle: The research of customer loss question of logistics enterprise based on the data mining
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The definition, importance of customer loss analysis of logistics enterprise was introduced briefly. The model procedure of customer loss analysis of logistics enterprise was studied, and the model of customer loss analysis was made by using data mining policy-making tree method. The actual experiment was done to test the model, the loss characters were found by analyzing the information of a railway logistics company customer. The result is useful to make precaution tactics and methods against customer loss.

articleTitle: Supply chain system planning in complex adaptive system perspective
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In complex adaptive system perspective, supply chain system planning is a kind of CAS planning. This paper provides multi-agents simulation method for supply chain system planning. Then it provides a model to plan the supply chain system with CAS theory. Finally it gives a simulation process using swarm software

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Electricity consumption and economic growth in China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Electricity Consumption and Economic Growth in China"
by Haipeng Wang, Peng Tian, and Ping Jin
in Proceedings of the 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, vol. 2, pp 1331-1334.

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper is a near duplication of the original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:
"Electricity Consumption and Economic Growth in China"
by Alice Shiu and Pun-Lee Lam,
in Energy Policy, vol. 32, no. 1, Jan 2004, Elsevier, pp 47-54.
This paper applies the cointegration and error correction model to examine the causal relationship between electricity consumption and economic growth for China during 1953-2003. Our estimation results indicate that real GDP and electricity consumption for China are cointegrated and there is unidirectional Granger causality running from electricity consumption to real GDP but not vice versa. In order to overcome the constraints on electricity consumption, the Chinese government has to speed up the nation-wide interconnection of power networks, to upgrade urban and rural distribution grids, and to accelerate rural electrification.

articleTitle: On the multi-objective stochastic optimal route of a mobile agent in multi-provider network QoS with uncertain parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In order to determine an optimal route, the network performance and cost of many network providers must be compared when end-user visit the content provided by content provider under the certain QoS constraints in multi-provider network. The correlative network information is collected by mobile agent. The delay and cost between any two nodes of network is set to be random variables. The minimum model with expectation of cost and delay value is presented in a stochastic network. The optimal solution of mobile agent route from service provider to content provider is computed and using genetic algorithms. In a case scenario of data simulation, the result obtained show operation effectiveness of the above approach.

articleTitle: A key agreement protocol using mutual authentication for ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Security is the major concern on designing a communications network. As for ad-hoc networks, the security problem is much more complicated than that of conventional networks. In this paper, the problem of securely generating and distributing a group key to group members of an ad-hoc network is addressed. A key agreement protocol using mutual authentication is proposed. The idea of using the XOR operator suggested in a previous study is adopted. By using mutual authentication, the proposed protocol prevents both replay attack and password-guessing attack, which are two potential problems in the previous study. To further enhance security, a rekeying mechanism is introduced for updating the group key if there were no changes in group members. Both security and complexity analyses show that the proposed protocol is not only securer but also more efficient than other well-known key agreement protocols.

articleTitle: Service pricing, agent efficiency and membership commitment in mixed duopsonies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The agricultural co-ops are the leading and oriented organizational pattern of agricultural industrialization in China. But during the process of co-ops there exists the problem of attracting more producers to join by improving its competence with the IOF. In this paper we present a simple two-stages mixed duopsonies model where the co-op and IOF compete in the input market. The impact on member commitment of pricing strategy of co-op and IOF are analyzed through the comparison of welfare of members. The results indicate that the objective set by co-op affects the pricing strategy as well as agent efficiency of co-op, which then has significant effect on member commitment. Implications for government policies and management rules are also discussed.

articleTitle: A framework for the evolution of e-business based on information technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In era of the network economy, it's very important for the enterprises to set up an effective e-business strategy. After intensive study of the law of e-business evolution, we provide a four-stage model of e-business evolution based on information technology, and the specific features of application of each stage also are described. Then the inner drive and key effects are analyzed in four aspects, they are IT application, corporation strategy, competence of IT and power of relationship. In the end, we conclude some suggestions and rules about how enterprise should do in establishing their e-business strategy based on the evolution model, which is valuable for real business practice.

articleTitle: Traffic flow operation design for public activities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Public activities have impact on the whole traffic operation system, which require the practitioners to prepare the traffic management plan for those events. In this study, we mainly introduce the process to develop a traffic flow operation design for public activity, and describe some models in the perdition process, especially, put forward the innovative idea of amending the rode impedance function to reflect the impact of traffic information on traveler route choice. Those concepts are incarnated in the practice case represented in the following. The contents describes here may be of interest to traffic management practitioners to solve the problem in traffic operation induced by public activities.

articleTitle: Research on logistics distribution center location model and evaluation under electronic commerce
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Consider the particularity of logistics distribution under electronic-commerce environment, logistics distribution center location model is revised from alternative expenses and terms of time-constrain, and set up model under electronic commerce environment Because the location model is an NP problem, heuristic algorithm is adopted to solve this problem. But the logistics distribution center location under e-commerce environment involves many factors; it's difficult to consider all the factors during the course of establishing the logistics distribution center location. Therefore, it is very necessary to ask for the experts' opinion and advice and do some qualitative decisions. On the basis of this hypothesis, this study makes certain the logistics distribution center location under electronic commerce using the combined method of quantitative heuristic arithmetic, and qualitative analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method.

articleTitle: A game model for selection of purchasing bids in consideration of fuzzy values
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: A number of efficiency-based vendor selection and negotiation models have been developed to deal with multiple attributes including price, quality and delivery performance which is treated as important bid attributes. But some alternative vendor's preferences of attributes are difficult of quantitative analysis, such as trust, reliability, and courtesy of the vendor, which are considered to be crucial issues of recent reaches in vendor evaluation. This paper proposes a buyer-seller game model that has distinct advantages over existing methods for bid selection and negotiation, the fuzzy indexes are used to evaluate those attributes which are difficult of quantitative analysis, we propose a new method that expands Talluri (2002) and Joe Zhu (2004)'s method and allows which the elements composing problems are given by fuzzy numerical values, An important outcome of assessing relative efficiencies within a group of decision making units (DMUs) in fuzzy data envelopment analysis is a set of virtual multipliers or weights accorded to each (input or output) factor taken into account. In this paper, by assessing upper bounds on factor weights and compacting the resulted intervals, a CSW is determined. Since resulted efficiencies by the proposed CSW are fuzzy numbers rather than crisp values, it is more informative for decision maker.

articleTitle: A new model for ERP assisted partnership development in outsourcing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The trend of contracting out activities will continue to grow to cover a much wider network of sub-contractors and become more complicated. Effective partnership development through scientific techniques has to be developed to overcome the sub-optimal approach of the traditional partnership development in an ad hoc manner. This research links daily information generated in the ERP system to optimal strategies using artificial intelligence technology and knowledge management technique to support a scientific and objective approach to partnership development It forms a regenerative feedback loop for a partnership development that maximizes benefits to both parties. The new partnership is developed through a strategy that involves close monitoring, and a set of scientific and transparent assessment, plus most important of all, feedback from reliable knowledge-based ERP generated data to push the collaboration forward. The main contribution of this paper is in the new model for ERP assisted partnership development in outsourcing which focuses on the knowledge-oriented methodology. It discusses the application of knowledge-oriented methodology in the different models of partnership development through case studies. It points out the differences between the traditional partnership information and the knowledge-oriented partnership information, and how they contribute to the new knowledge for enhancing the value of partnership development.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation in dual electric power markets for price-taker energy supplier
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Allocation problem is one of the most important problems faced by an electric energy supplier under new market environment. In this paper, dual markets allocation for price-taker generator is modeled and researched while considering price risk and optimizing its profit. The method and solution of optimal dual allocation for the price-taker generator is given out. The numerical simulation for market allocation is shown and suggestion for generator to select risk factor is given out based on simulation.

articleTitle: The game analysis of the competition between enterprise and alliance under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Under asymmetric information, when the enterprise out of league competes with alliance, we use the economic theory to analyze its expectation of achievements for the future. We find, if the strategic alliance is a competitive league, asymmetric information make the enterprise out of league adopt active policy positively. This is contrary to conventional wisdom, good information doesn't always mean positive.

articleTitle: Network surveillance and multi-group intrusion classification
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The early and reliable detection of malicious attacks is a crucial issue for today's network security and survivability. Different types of attacks may need different responses. Therefore, it is a meaningful task to predict the category of malicious attacks and take appropriate reactions. The goal of this paper is to apply multiple-criteria linear programming (MCLP) method to the multi-group intrusion classification problem. Specifically, we first collect a multi-group network intrusion dataset using Tenable NeWT Security Scanner. Five attack types and total of 9061 data records were captured. After that, MCLP five-group model was applied to the NeWT dataset. The classification accuracy of MCLP was compared with see5, a decision-tree-based classification tool. The experimental results of this research indicate that MCLP achieves comparable classification accuracy to see5.

articleTitle: An intelligent face recognition method based on artificial neural network and principle component
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We presented an intelligent face recognition method for remote identification services based on artificial neural network (ANN) and principle component analysis (PCA). Experiment results show that our method can reach reasonable identification accuracy with the balance between computation and convergence.

articleTitle: A study on profit allocation model based on integrated supply
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The integrator was introduced in a two-stage supply chain composed of supplier and manufacture, and the profit allocation problem for this kind of supply chain under integrated supply mode was studied. Based on the revenue sharing contracts, a model for profit allocation among integrator and supplier and manufacturer was built under the conditions of channel coordination and integrated supply. The feasible range and determined processes of the profit allocation parameters were given, and they were illustrated with an example.

articleTitle: Security policy selection method of pipeline transportation based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Due to various risk factors facing oil transportation through pipeline, many advanced technology have been devised to detect or eliminate the potential hazards. However, utilizing all the measures will be costly and in some case will not reap the desirable effects. Therefore the authors introduced the security policy selection method based on analytic hierarchy process. It will help operators to discern the most needed security policy. Finally, some concerns about the application of analytic hierarchy process and discuss about its resolutions were suggested.

articleTitle: Web-based portfolio management with multi-criteria decision and bundle trading
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: We propose a Web-based business model, which integrates the process of portfolio benchmarking, multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA), and the bundle trading, aiming to help the fund managers to make their investment decisions better by constructing efficient portfolios and re-balancing their portfolios online. In this model, a benchmark is defined firstly, and then the multi-criteria decision analysis is used to adjust the benchmark to a final efficient portfolio. Also, in the process of multi-criteria decision analysis, we consider the importance among the criteria by using a fuzzy set technique to weight the criteria. Once the portfolio allocations are made, fund managers may apply bundle trading system online to revise their allocations as conditions change.

articleTitle: Measuring integrated supply chain performance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Combining the traditional enterprise performance measurement method with the nature and the characteristics of integrated supply chain, this research determines the scope and contents of integrated supply chain performance measurement system. In line with the individual enterprise performance measurement method and theory, integrated supply chain performance measurement systems should reflect the strategy of integrated supply chain. At the same time, it should be able to check the efficiency of the strategy. According to the layer upon layer strategic objects of integrated supply chain, five key performance aspects (finance, business processes, customer, environment, core enterprise ability) are found. These five key performance fields are significant for the formation and improvement of integrated supply chain.

articleTitle: Study on enterprise operation model of time-based competition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The uncertainty increasing of the enterprise business circumstance and the changed mode and concept of people's consumption result in the competition among the enterprises from the focus on the cost, quality and service to the variety and time of the products gradually. Thus the time-based competition has become the research hotspot The time-based competition requires the enterprise to instantly respond the whole changing customer's requirement and changeful business positions, that is to say, the enterprise's whole business of R&D, supplying, manufacture, sale and marketing is organized around the requirement of zero time with the specific manifestation of customized mode, which is called zero time organization. This paper will raise the primary thoughts about the specific requirement of zero time organization and its application.

articleTitle: The determinants of timeliness of company's financial reporting service: evidence from China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: This study extends the timeliness of annual financial reporting service research to China's emerging capital market With a sample of listed Chinese firms for 1999-2003, we find that both audit opinions and earnings surprises have significant effects on the timing of financial reporting service, and a significant effect attributable to the magnitude of negative earnings surprises. In particular, it is found that a significant interaction effect exists between audit opinions and earnings surprises, that is, Positive earnings surprises with modified audit opinions are announced significantly later than unqualified negative earnings surprises.

articleTitle: A membership function solution to multiple-server fuzzy queues
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: Problems of multiple-server fuzzy queues are often encountered in service industry, such as in hospital clinics. Herein, a membership function of the performance measure of multiple-server fuzzy queues with the arrival rate and service rate are fuzzy numbers is derived, in which α-cut and Zadeh's extension principle are applied to transform multiple-server fuzzy queues to a family of conversional multiple-server queues, and a pair of parametric programs is formulated to calculate the upper and lower bounds of the performance measure. As α varies, the membership function of the expected sojourn time per patient in the clinic with 2-server fuzzy queues is solved in the presented numerical example. Since the performance measures are expressed by membership functions rather than by crisp values, more information is provided for managerial decision-making in hospitals.

articleTitle: A two-level distribution network design based on inventory cost optimization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In this paper, we address more complex distribution network design problems, which involve facility location, transportation and inventory decisions. The main contribution of this paper is the formulation of a multi-echelon distribution network design problem (MEDND) which made up of competitive and non-competitive facilities, and the incorporation of tactical and operational decisions into the facility location problem solution scheme. We present a non-linear mixed-integer model and a heuristic solution approach, based on Lagrangian relaxation (LR) and the sub-gradient method. In a number application we found that the potential cost reduction, compared to the traditional approach, increases when the holding and service level are higher, especially when the severe competitive exists in the market.

articleTitle: An optimization model for distribution network design with uncertain customer demands and production capacity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy linear programming model for bi-level distribution network design in supply chain management (SCM) is proposed, in which both customer demands for products and production capacity of branch plants are treated as fuzzy parameters. Then a fuzzy chance constrained programming model is presented to denote the problem further. The ways to convert chance constraints to their respective crisp equivalents are also discussed. To speed up the process of solving the problem, a heuristic method is combined with conventional branch and bound algorithm and satisfactory results have been achieved. A numerical example is given to illustrate the proposed model at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Differentiated products combination pricing strategy in supply chain
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: The pricing strategy of differentiated products in supply chain was studied in the paper. Firstly, we developed a two-stage differentiated products supply chain model. By building Nash game model, we got the Nash equilibrium solution to manufacturer and retailer's product pricing strategy. The existence of the unique Nash equilibrium solution was proved. By using numerical simulation to analyze the combination pricing strategy of differentiated products, we got the laws of changes in combination pricing strategy, manufacturer's profits and retailer's profits with the variety of product cost, management cost, and the parameters of market demand. The result is consistent with economics principle.

articleTitle: Study on a roadmapping system as a decision making process for supporting scientific research
publicationTitle: Proceedings of ICSSSM '05. 2005 International Conference on Services Systems and Services Management, 2005.
abstract: With the development of Internet, researchers can easily obtain a great quantity of data and information, but sorting through that data and information to find new research topics, to support knowledge management and knowledge creation, is not a trivial problem. So, how researchers can utilize the vast amount of available data and information to make decisions regarding their future research is an extremely important research field. Who provides such service and how to provide such service for researchers in a university setting are the problem addressing in this research. As we all know, in industry, they manage technology as a strategy to make more benefit and provide more service called MOT. After comparison between management of technology in industry and scientific research (SR) in university, we get a conclusion that the purpose, the object, the result are different between management of technology in industry and scientific research in university, but the process is very similar. In this research, we used a process method of MOT called roadmapping to build a roadmapping system as a decision making process for supporting scientific research in a university setting. The contribution of this research is to provide the service to researchers in university supporting them to find new research topics from a great quantity of data and information.
